lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately five to six vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with the highest-luminance maxima concentrated in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Light vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a structured grid-like pattern across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, each exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the upper edge and defined shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower right quadrant is clearly visible, showing a high density of small, discrete high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the blobs on the lateral flank.
